picks.title: X100 Exploit Proceeds Split Into Four 400-ETH Wallets
picks.summary: The first exploiter swapped about 4.75 million USDT into ether, while the distribution wallet retained another 423 ETH.

picks.title: Electrum Patches Wallet Flaw Exploited Through Malicious Servers
picks.summary: A malicious server can substitute a fake payment, then trick the user into signing it while raising the transaction fee. Developers say one user reported losing money.

picks.title: Third X100 Exploit Transaction Pulls 550,000 X From Uniswap Pool
picks.summary: A different sender routed about 549,916 X and 1,909 USDT to a new beneficiary, while the affected pool held less than 200 USDT.

picks.title: X100 Exploit Nets 4.85 Million USDT After Governance Takeover
picks.summary: Two transactions turned treasury tokens and liquidity positions into USDT; Blockaid warned that the Ethereum attack was ongoing.

picks.title: BlackX UEFI bootkit exploits Baton Drop flaw to bypass Secure Boot
picks.summary: A new UEFI bootkit named BlackX, deployed in an espionage campaign in early 2026, exploited the old Baton Drop vulnerability to bypass Secure Boot and load a malicious driver designed to interfere with security solutions from Kaspersky and Avast. [...]

picks.title: Keystone Website Breach Exposes Customer Addresses and Order Details
picks.summary: The hardware-wallet maker says it blocked access and fixed the vulnerability. Payment details, recovery phrases and private keys were not exposed, according to the company.

picks.title: Quest Diagnostics confirms data breach exposed patient records
picks.summary: American clinical laboratory company Quest Diagnostics disclosed that patient records have been exposed after a threat actor gained unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system. [...]
